reviews.title: Great game lots of potential
reviews.text: Im a huge supporter of life simulation games and have been playing them for almost a decade. When I found this game I stopped playing any other life simulator games. The thing I like the most is that the developer seems to refuse to lock content behind a paywall unlike most other developers. The game is not perfect but when there is an issue or bug the developer fixes it within a timely manner and keeps their audience up to date with what is going on. I’m pretty sure it is only one developer and the game does not feel that way it feels as if there are multiple people working on it. I haven’t seen so much stuff to do in many different ways in any other game. I look forward to what this game will be in the future and continuing to play throughout the process.
